title: Implement Solo setup with a five-to-ten player stepper
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement Solo setup using a minus/count/plus control for exactly 5–10 total players, bot temperament/difficulty and duration choices from the reviewed local-session contract. Do not create 5/7/9 pseudo-modes or expose bot secret roles. Explain that bots obey the same rules/information as humans. Start simulation emits a local-authority setup intent; it never depends on Firebase. Before engine/bot integration exists, keep start unavailable with a concrete reason rather than promote the hardcoded clickthrough to a real game. Keep configuration, not outcomes, in this component.
acceptance: Player stepper reaches each integer5–10 and cannot step outside bounds; no synthetic presets are presented as game modes.
Difficulty/duration selection is conveyed accessibly and produces one exact approved setup payload.
Real Solo start is gated on the local engine/bot adapter, with no Firebase configuration/authentication requirement.
No other role or bot private evidence leaks through setup labels, previews or emitted payloads.
designSections: SCREEN-FLOW: 4. Single-player setup; GDD-v0: Plataformas y modos
